=== switch one case
start
switch (test?)
case (only)
  :A;
endswitch
stop
=== switch two cases
start
switch (test?)
case (one)
  :A;
case (two)
  :B;
endswitch
stop
=== switch five cases
switch (a very long test condition here?)
case (c1)
  :Action one;
case (c2)
  :Two;
case (c3)
  :Three is longer;
case (c4)
  :4;
case (c5)
  :Five;
endswitch
:after;
=== switch empty cases
switch (x)
case (a)
case (b)
case (c)
endswitch
=== switch one empty case
switch (x)
case (a)
endswitch
=== switch stop in cases
switch (x)
case (a)
  :A;
  stop
case (b)
  :B;
case (c)
  :C;
  kill
endswitch
:Z;
=== switch all stop
switch (x)
case (a)
  stop
case (b)
  end
endswitch
=== switch first and last stop
switch (x)
case (a)
  stop
case (b)
  :B;
case (c)
  :C;
case (d)
  :D;
  detach
endswitch
:after;
=== switch colors
#pink:switch (x)
case (a)
  :A;
case (b)
  :B;
endswitch <<#lightblue>>
=== switch long labels
switch (some test)
case (a really really long case label that goes on)
  :A;
case (short)
  :B with a long action text inside it;
case (x)
  :C;
endswitch
=== switch multiline case
switch (multi\nline\ntest)
case (first\nline)
  :A;
case (second)
  :B\nmulti\nline;
endswitch
=== switch nested
switch (outer)
case (o1)
  switch (inner)
  case (i1)
    :X;
  case (i2)
    :Y;
  endswitch
case (o2)
  :Z;
endswitch
=== switch arrows
switch (x)
case (a)
  :A;
  -> out a;
case (b)
  -[#red]-> colored;
  :B;
case (c)
  :C;
  -[#blue,dashed]->
endswitch
:end;
=== switch empty test
switch ()
case (a)
  :A;
case (b)
  :B;
endswitch
=== switch wide middle
switch (t)
case (1)
  :A;
case (2)
  :A very very very wide middle action box;
case (3)
  :C;
endswitch
=== switch narrow big diamond
switch (an extremely long condition text that makes the diamond very wide indeed)
case (1)
  :A;
case (2)
  :B;
case (3)
  :C;
endswitch
=== switch big diamond two
switch (an extremely long condition text that makes the diamond very wide indeed)
case (1)
  :A;
case (2)
  :B;
endswitch
=== switch swimlanes
|Lane1|
start
switch (x)
case (a)
  |Lane2|
  :A;
case (b)
  |Lane1|
  :B;
endswitch
|Lane1|
stop
=== switch swimlanes three
|A|
:start;
switch (x)
case (one)
  :in A;
case (two)
  |B|
  :in B;
case (three)
  |C|
  :in C;
endswitch
|A|
:end;
=== switch case goto
switch (x)
case (a)
  label here
  :A;
case (b)
  :B;
endswitch
=== fork two
start

  :B;
end fork
stop
=== fork three
start

  :A;
fork again
  :B is longer;
fork again
  :C;
end fork
stop

  :A;

  :B;
end merge

  :A;

  :B;

  :C;

:after;
=== fork end fork label

  :A;

end fork {or}

fork
  :A;
fork again
  :B;
end fork {join spec with a long label}
:after;
=== fork color
fork <<#red>>
  :A;
fork again
  :B;
end fork
=== fork color merge
fork <<#green>>
  :A;
fork again
  :B;
end merge
=== fork arrows labels
fork
  -> in label;
  :A;
  -> out label;
fork again
  :B;
  -> other;
end fork
=== fork arrows colors
fork
  -[#red]->
  :A;
  -[#blue]->
fork again
  -[#green,bold]-> green;
  :B;
end fork
=== fork kill branches
fork
  :A;
  kill
fork again
  :B;
end fork
:after;

  :A;
  detach

  detach
end fork

  :A;
  stop

  :B;

  :C;
  end
end fork
:after;

fork again
end fork

  fork again
    :B2;
  end merge
end fork
